How do I put an IPTV playlist or a film on the TV without a USB stick?
«Apps» tab → «Send a file to the TV» → «Choose a file». The file appears on the TV in «Download» → «TVCleanzer». Then add the playlist in your IPTV app: «Add playlist» → «File».
How do I search by voice?

«Remote» → the microphone in the text field → say what to find. The search opens in the app that’s on the TV screen right now (YouTube and others). The ➤ button types the text into a text field on the TV.
How do I turn on music in the photo frame?
«Launcher» tab → «Photo frame» → «Add music». It plays while the photo frame is on screen, and without photos — under the clock. Volume with the TV remote.
How do I remove the greeting, make the clock smaller or hide the memory pill?
«Launcher» tab → home screen look: «Greeting», «Clock at the top», «Date and weather on one line», «Memory on the home screen». The same on the TV: gear → launcher settings.
What do the network icon colours mean?
Green — internet works, blue — a VPN is on, orange — connected but no internet (router, provider or VPN), red — no network.

How do I make icons round?

«Launcher» tab → «Icons and tiles» → «Icon shape» → «Round». With «Auto» only the icons in the dock and «Showcase» turn round; for round icons everywhere pick «Icons» in «App icons». On the TV: gear → launcher settings → «Icon shape».
